messages:
maria: Heads-up — the Console's "Apply suggestion" button is proposing fixes for routing YAML that change header matcher shape. That can silently change route precedence and cause traffic to go to the wrong model. We should not auto-apply these without an explicit safe/unsafe indicator.

alex: Do you have an example? I thought the autofix was only renames and whitespace.

maria: here's a minimal repro. Original route we save:
```yaml
- name: user-precedent-route
  match:
    path: /v1/generate
    header_matchers:
      - name: x-tenant-id
        type: exact
        value: internal
  target: model-a
  weight: 100
```
Console suggests converting `header_matchers` -> `headers` and flattening into a map: 
```yaml
- name: user-precedent-route
  match:
    path: /v1/generate
    headers:
      x-tenant-id: internal
  target: model-a
  weight: 100
```
That looks harmless, but the runtime's header matcher supports `type: prefix` and `anchored: true` flags which are lost by the autofix. In our real configs some routes relied on anchored prefix semantics; after autofix those become simple exact matches and precedence changes.

tom: ugh. So the autofix is lossy. We should classify suggestions by whether they are semantics-preserving or not. If not-preserving -> show as "proposal" only, not apply.

alex: Agree. Quick proposal: add a diff preview panel showing the structural delta and a little badge: [safe] or [breaking]. Also surface the schema version that generated the suggestion.

rachel: Repro steps I used locally: 1) checkout route yaml; 2) open in Console editor; 3) click lint -> suggestion applied; 4) run unit routing test against envoy staging -> route matched wrong cluster. I can paste failing test log if helpful.

rachel: failing snippet: 
```
ASSERT route_for(headers={"x-tenant-id":"internalish"}) == model-b
ACTUAL model-a  # because anchored prefix changed to exact
```

infra-bot: lint-scan completed for PR #8421 at 2027-06-14T10:22:01Z — suggestion: header_shorthand_conversion (severity: suggestion) :eyes:

maria: So two separate fixes: 1) Console UX change to *not* autorewrite lossy transformations; 2) Linter ruleset update to mark lossy rewrites as `error` or `propose-only` with explicit migration steps.

alex: Implementation notes: - Add an analyzer pass that compares the AST before/after suggestion; if semantics-diff detected, mark as breaking. - Add a small "Apply anyway (unsafe)" confirm modal with explicit checklist. - Expose an API flag `?autofix=unsafe=true` that the pre-commit hook must not set by default.

tom: For CI/pre-commit: default behavior should be to fail PRs that contain suggestions flagged as breaking. We can provide a `lint:allow-suggestions` opt-in file for repos that want auto-migrations.

rachel: Also, telemetry: record how often users click "Apply suggestion" and whether subsequent deploys roll back. We'll need tracing hooks.

maria: Agreed. Action items: alex - spike on diff preview + badge. tom - update linter severity rules and make a pre-commit config that blocks unsafe autofix. rachel - gather 2 more repros and attach unit tests. I'll draft a short RFC for Console copy & modals.

alex: I'll aim for a spike by EOD Friday.

tom: I'll update the lint rules PR and add tests.

rachel: I'll paste the extra logs in this thread later.

maria: thanks everyone. Adding a short note: do NOT enable `autofix=true` in CI for any production repos until we have the safety badge. :warning:
notes: thread about Console autofix proposing lossy YAML changes; contains YAML/code snippets and action items
